MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Record keeping in aquaculture? (1 mark)

   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Record keeping in aquaculture.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Record keeping in aquaculture.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Record keeping in aquaculture.

   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week

   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

11. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

   B. Glucose and oxygen
